description:
Find players (and rookie picks) by name and get their current dynasty market value, positional rank, and tier.

USE WHEN: you need to resolve a name before grading a trade, or the user asks what someone is worth.
Returns several candidates when the name is ambiguous — pick the right one rather than guessing.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

query.description: Player name or fragment — 'Bijan', 'Marvin Harrison', '2026 1st'. Partial names are fine.

name: tradegauge_search_players
title: Search players by name
